meta.title: Quote selection (dsh-client-ui-quote)
meta.description: Select any sentence in the chat, a file preview or the terminal to quote it. Kimi Code is the starting point, but this version treats a quote as an object you can manage, review and carry back: the floating bar offers Comment, Add to conversation and Side chat, the first two insert a DSH reference chip into the composer, and the third writes the quote into the composer of one independent side thread per conversation in the right sidebar without sending it (needs dsh-better-sidebar). Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B do the same three things, hovering a sent quote can jump back to its source, and the right sidebar's Quote list page searches every quote of the session, jumps back to any of them and exports them as Markdown (Alt+L), its footer takes a side thread's conclusion back into the main composer or exports it as a file, and a hover card action revises a sent quote (the old capsule is then marked as superseded). The quoted sentence keeps a highlight and ordinal in its source message, a 引用 ×N bar above the composer lists the draft's quotes and removes them one by one, and the sent ref line names the turn and role it came from in readable words. Diff and per-turn change panels are quotable too, and the quote list inserts a multi-selected set in one action.
